summary: Tested all 6 new features + regression on Avni Bhardwaj portfolio. Backend /api/github/contributions passes (200, ~371 days, 129 total). Frontend: chapter titles all visible (transform=none), project overlays open/close via X + ESC + backdrop for jobhunt & fake-news, airbus card opens overlay WITHOUT github button (correct), GitHub heatmap renders (26 week columns, 208 cells, 'N contributions this year' text), flight path visible on 1920px, flight-stop-contact scrolls to contact section, now-clock ticks (verified change over 2s), now-building & now-listening populated, weather '—' acceptable per spec. Terminal, gesture-guide modal, certificates (14 discs), motion-toggle, theme-toggle all work. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Experience.tsx (~551 lines) is approaching the 700-line soft limit; ProjectOverlay + Card + PROJECTS data could be split into separate modules for maintainability.
GitHub heatmap total value (129) is small; if this is not the expected value for Avni's account, verify the GraphQL query date-range in server.py.
Weather API from Open-Meteo silently fails to '—' in sandbox (expected per spec) — consider surfacing a subtle retry or last-known-good value in production.
test_credentials: Not required for main site (stats page not in scope).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 new features verified working. Overlay close via X initially appeared to fail because AnimatePresence exit animation was still running at 500ms; using >=1000ms wait confirms element removal.
